description: Probe-only rejection library for HIP_MLOPS_ENGINE Layernorm backward with saved mean and inverse variance (runs on gfx950; no arch gate in the engine, LayernormPlanBuilder.cpp:76-172). Template: quick LayernormBackward/Variant2; every case is a graph the frontend accepts (LayernormBackwardNode.hpp pre_validate: equal shapes of dy, x, dx, of mean and inv_variance, of dscale, dbias and scale; normalized_dim_count 1 with a one-padded scale and mean for the rank probes). Classes covered: mixed dtypes, int32/uint32 overflow, odd dims, rank, declared alignment. Non-dense and padded strides are out of scope. There is no ndc family: the backward frontend validates a non-zero normalized_dim_count against scale and mean (LayernormBackwardNode.hpp, the block after the shape checks), so a mismatching value is not a legal graph. `expect` is `declined` where the engine code shows it must decline or, for a gap, would compute something else, and `declined_or_pass` where a correct engine may take the graph and the references can grade it (the (dy, scale/stats, dx) combinations of LayernormBpropSignatureKey.hpp getPlanBuilders). none: the control, pure float/half/bfloat16, ordinary rank 4 or 5, scale/dscale/dbias covering the trailing axes from k, mean and inv_variance covering the leading axes: `declined_or_pass`. odd_dims: every dim of x not divisible by 4; no divisibility gate in the engine: `declined_or_pass`. dt_scale_f: x, dy and dx half or bfloat16 with float scale, dscale, dbias and statistics: the plan types x, dy, affine and statistics separately (LayernormBwdPlan.cpp:153-161): `declined_or_pass`. dt_dy_f: x and dx half or bfloat16, dy float (registered combination): the kernel reads dy as OutputType = dy's dtype (LayernormBwdPlan.cpp:154, LayernormBwd.cpp:8): `declined_or_pass`. dt_dx_neq_x [known gap]: x float with dx half or bfloat16 (dy float, affine and statistics float; registered by the reference, which keys on dy and dx). The plan types x as InputType and the kernel writes dx as InputType (LayernormBwdPlan.cpp:153, LayernormBwd.cpp:13,86); the validator only checks each io tensor against the allowed set (LayernormApplicabilityChecks.cpp:142-150), so the engine writes 4 bytes per element into a 2-byte buffer. Expected `declined`; an accept is WRONG. dt_dscale, dt_dbias: dscale or dbias differ from scale in dtype: scale, dscale and dbias share one dtype (LayernormApplicabilityChecks.cpp:152-158, ids built at :255-256): `declined`. dt_mean_inv: mean and inv_variance differ in dtype (LayernormApplicabilityChecks.cpp:160-166): `declined`. dt_x_bad, dt_dy_bad, dt_dx_bad: x, dy or dx is int32, double or uint8 (LayernormApplicabilityChecks.cpp:142-150): `declined`. dt_affine_bad (scale, dscale, dbias) and dt_stat_bad (mean, inv_variance): dtypes outside the allowed sets (:152-166): `declined`. rank_2, rank_3, rank_6: rank 2, 3 or 6 with the last axis normalized, packed row-major; the engine takes rank 4 or 5 only (ApplicabilityChecks.cpp:31-41 validateDimensionCount via LayernormApplicabilityChecks.cpp:117-135, called at :272): `declined`. align: every device tensor declares the same alignment (1, 2, 4 or 8 bytes; powers of two only, because the backend rejects an execute whose pointer is not a multiple of the declared alignment, hip_kernel_provider_common/DeclaredAlignment.hpp:14-17); a tensor whose declared alignment is not a multiple of its element size makes the engine decline (LayernormPlanBuilder.cpp:129-135, DeclaredAlignment.hpp:79-84): `declined` when the alignment is not a multiple of 2 or (not a multiple of 4 and some tensor is float), else `declined_or_pass`. overflow: `ovf` selects x_2_31 and x_2_32 (2**31 / 2**32 elements), inner_2_31 / inner_2_32 (one row of that many elements) and outer_2_32 (2**32 rows), built at enforcement_level buildable. isApplicable has no overflow gate; the kernels index with 32-bit unsigned constants (LayernormCommon.hpp:8-11, x_idx at :35) and buildPlan throws only when outerSize * stride >= UINT32_MAX (LayernormBwdPlan.cpp:163-169), so outer_2_32 ends in a build exception (a CRASH finding) and the others are accepted by the engine: all `declined` (known gaps; an accepted and built case is reported UNEXERCISED with the reason `accepted above the oracle ceiling`). Not reachable from a space: compute_data_type, is_override_shape_enabled, ragged tensors, epsilon dtype, and a missing mean or inv_variance (no way to drop a tensor from the template without leaving an orphan). The space is written for gfx950, the only device available; the engine runs there. It is probe-only: never frozen into a bundle. Axes (few on purpose, so the pairwise proof stays cheap): `family`; `shape` (ndim, n, c, d3, h, w, first normalized axis k, layout: 8 combinations covering rank 4 and 5, NCHW and NHWC and every split k); `odd` (n, c, d, h, w, none divisible by 4, read only by odd_dims); `x_dtype` (the base dtype of the pure families); `aux` (low-precision dtype, unsupported dtype, declared alignment, saved statistics, inv_rms dtype: 8 combinations, each family reads only the components it needs); `ovf` (the overflow variants).

derive.rank_r: 2 if family == 'rank_2' else (3 if family == 'rank_3' else 6)
derive.dd: (odd_d if is_odd else d3) if ndim == 5 else 1
derive.xs_h: ww if layout == 'nchw' else ww * cc
derive.xs_d: hh * ww if layout == 'nchw' else hh * ww * cc
derive.xs_c: dd * hh * ww if layout == 'nchw' else 1
derive.ps_h: pw if layout == 'nchw' else pw * pc
derive.ps_d: ph * pw if layout == 'nchw' else ph * pw * pc
derive.ps_c: pd * ph * pw if layout == 'nchw' else 1
derive.ss_h: sw if layout == 'nchw' else sw * sc
derive.ss_d: sh * sw if layout == 'nchw' else sh * sw * sc
derive.ss_c: sd * sh * sw if layout == 'nchw' else 1
derive.b_dims_x: [nn, cc, hh, ww] if ndim == 4 else [nn, cc, dd, hh, ww]
derive.b_dims_p: [1, pc, ph, pw] if ndim == 4 else [1, pc, pd, ph, pw]
derive.b_dims_s: [nn, sc, sh, sw] if ndim == 4 else [nn, sc, sd, sh, sw]
derive.b_str_x: [xs_n, xs_c, xs_h, xs_w] if ndim == 4 else [xs_n, xs_c, xs_d, xs_h, xs_w]
derive.b_str_p: [ps_n, ps_c, ps_h, ps_w] if ndim == 4 else [ps_n, ps_c, ps_d, ps_h, ps_w]
derive.b_str_s: [ss_n, ss_c, ss_h, ss_w] if ndim == 4 else [ss_n, ss_c, ss_d, ss_h, ss_w]
derive.r_dims_x: [nn, ww] if rank_r == 2 else ([nn, cc, ww] if rank_r == 3 else [nn, cc, dd, hh, 2, ww])
derive.r_dims_p: [1, ww] if rank_r == 2 else ([1, 1, ww] if rank_r == 3 else [1, 1, 1, 1, 1, ww])
derive.r_dims_s: [nn, 1] if rank_r == 2 else ([nn, cc, 1] if rank_r == 3 else [nn, cc, dd, hh, 2, 1])
derive.r_str_x: [ww, 1] if rank_r == 2 else ([cc * ww, ww, 1] if rank_r == 3 else [cc * dd * hh * 2 * ww, dd * hh * 2 * ww, hh * 2 * ww, 2 * ww, ww, 1])
derive.r_str_p: [ww, 1] if rank_r == 2 else ([ww, ww, 1] if rank_r == 3 else [ww, ww, ww, ww, ww, 1])
derive.r_str_s: [1, 1] if rank_r == 2 else ([cc, 1, 1] if rank_r == 3 else [cc * dd * hh * 2, dd * hh * 2, hh * 2, 2, 1, 1])
derive.ob: 2**32 if ovf == 'outer_2_32' else (1 if ovf in ['inner_2_31', 'inner_2_32'] else 2)
derive.ow: 2**15 if ovf in ['x_2_31', 'x_2_32'] else (2**31 if ovf == 'inner_2_31' else (2**32 if ovf == 'inner_2_32' else 4))
derive.dims_x: [ob, 1, oh, ow] if ov else (r_dims_x if rk else b_dims_x)
derive.dims_p: [1, 1, 1, ow] if ov else (r_dims_p if rk else b_dims_p)
derive.dims_s: [ob, 1, oh, 1] if ov else (r_dims_s if rk else b_dims_s)
derive.stride_x: [oh * ow, oh * ow, ow, 1] if ov else (r_str_x if rk else b_str_x)
derive.stride_p: [ow, ow, ow, 1] if ov else (r_str_p if rk else b_str_p)
derive.stride_s: [oh, oh, 1, 1] if ov else (r_str_s if rk else b_str_s)
derive.nd: 1 if (rk or ov) else ndim - k
derive.tx: bad_dt if family == 'dt_x_bad' else ('float' if family == 'dt_dx_neq_x' else d0)
derive.tdy: bad_dt if family == 'dt_dy_bad' else ('float' if family in ['dt_dy_f', 'dt_dx_neq_x'] else d0)
derive.tp: bad_dt if family == 'dt_affine_bad' else ('float' if mixed else d0)
derive.unc: family == 'align' and (al % 2 != 0 or (al % 4 != 0 and 'float' in [tx, tdy, tdx, tp, tds, tdb, tm, ti]))

expect: ${'declined_or_pass' if (family in ['none', 'odd_dims', 'dt_scale_f', 'dt_dy_f'] or (family == 'align' and not unc)) else 'declined'}
